description: Skill selection for this template: packs and profiles plus the two agent roles. Each skill's metadata (description, argument-hint) lives in its playbook frontmatter at playbooks/skills/<bucket>/<name>.md, not here. Runtime wrappers and .claude-plugin/plugin.json are generated from playbook frontmatter plus .agents/skills.enabled.json.

architecture.description: Architecture exploration, refactor planning, critique, and interface design workflows.

core.description: Broadly useful coding, debugging, planning, execution, review, and task basics.

cross-repo.description: Feature contracts and PR reviews spanning multiple repos or deployable surfaces.

database.description: Database migration safety review and generation guidance.

dev-tooling.description: Repository tooling setup and skill-authoring workflows.

docs-knowledge.description: Durable docs, context refresh, component maps, and knowledge distillation.

github.description: GitHub issue triage, issue creation, QA, and PRD-to-issue workflows.

platform-claude.description: Claude Code-specific setup and guardrail workflows.

security.description: Security review and secure-coding workflows (OWASP Top 10, ASVS, LLM/Agentic AI).

simplicity.description: Minimal-correct-change review, over-engineering audits, and simplification debt tracking.

task-management.description: Inbox, roadmap, PRD, backlog, and task-system maintenance workflows.

ui.description: Frontend creation and rendered UI review skills.

writing.description: Personal writing and manuscript-review workflows: deslopping, article editing, and scientific writing.

full.description: Activate every user-facing skill pack in the library.

minimal.description: Small default for code work with task execution discipline.

recommended.description: Core coding workflow plus UI and task-management skills.

implementer.description: Act as an implementer for a single task slice. Use when the user wants Codex to implement focused work from a plan, following the subagent protocol with scope fencing and structured reporting.

reviewer.description: Two-stage review of implementation work. Use when the user wants Codex to review completed task output for spec compliance and code quality.
